sections.Profile:
Bram Stoker's Dracula , released by Williams in April 1993, is a four-player machine with a dot-matrix display based on the 1992 film, in which the player defeats Dracula's minions and his concubines, the Three Sisters. Designed by Barry Oursler and Mark Sprenger, it lets the Castle, Coffin and Mist multiballs run together, starting Mist Multiball when the player knocks loose a ball that a magnet carries across the playfield, and it is known for its unforgiving difficulty.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1993
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 4

sections.Getting Started (Kineticist tutorial):
James' Keys to the Game

- Get comfy with how the ball comes out of the bumpers, and then figure out how to shoot the left ramp repeatedly.
- Scoring is 2x or 3x when playing two or three multiballs simultaneously. The goal is to get all three going at once.
- To start each multiball:
  - Castle: Shooting the left ramp or standup three-banks around the playfield lights locks. Left ramp locks balls. Prioritize the left ramp, not the targets.
  - Mist: Lit at the upper left hole after enough left ramps.
  - Coffin: Shooting the right ramp lights locks, also at the right ramp. Three locks starts multiball.
- The left ramp alternates between lighting Castle locks and Coffin locks as the "bonus" awarded every six ramps. If Coffin locks are already lit, this will always light Castle locks. Unlike the Castle, Coffin locks are easy to get without the left ramp, so make sure that Coffin locks are lit prior to collecting that bonus.

James' Keys to the Game

- To play each multiball:
  - Castle: Shooting left ramp locks the ball and lights the jackpot for a few seconds. Locking a second ball doubles the jackpot for a few seconds. Shoot the Mist hole to collect the jackpot when lit.
  - Mist: All shots are worth 10,000,000 points. Loop the left ramp.
  - Coffin: Right ramp spells DRACULA which awards a jackpot upon completion.
- Castle is the most valuable and should be all you focus on during a triple multiball. Mist is decently valuable and can be used for reliable points. Coffin should be ignored.
- Left ramp shots also start Bats, which is completed by collecting 15 switches as fast as possible and is awarded in every bonus for the rest of the game. Getting a good bats scored early can be worth a few hundred million.
